svg.text: A document authoring language for humans
Polyester is a document authoring language that occupies an interesting niche in the
markup landscape. It combines the readability of Markdown with the structured power of
LaTeX, sitting alongside Typst as a modern alternative for document creation.
Polyester uses a /command syntax that's intuitive and readable. Unlike LaTeX's backslash
escapes or Typst's hash-based functions, Polyester commands feel more like CLI
Commands start with / at the beginning of a line
Plain Markdown flows naturally between commands
No need to wrap everything in special syntax
Positional args, quoted strings, flags, and blocks all coexist cleanly.
This functional chaining is unique—neither Markdown, LaTeX, nor Typst have this pattern
Curly braces contain nested content, enabling structured layouts without escaping into a
Polyester borrows heavily from React's mental model:
Components - Reusable building blocks with defined interfaces
Props as flags - /button primary "Label" --href "/path" mirrors <Button variant="primary" href="/path">Label</Button>
Children as blocks - { content } is like {children} in JSX
Composition - Nest components freely to build complex layouts
The difference: Polyester targets documents, not applications. No state, no hooks, no
reactivity—just declarative markup that compiles to static output.
Polyester includes 27 built-in components across four categories:
page - Document setup (size, margins, orientation, pagination)
columns - Multi-column layouts with configurable gap
grid - CSS grid layouts with template definitions
region - Styled container with background and padding
sidebar - Two-panel layout with fixed sidebar
frame - Bordered box with radius options
inline - Horizontal arrangement with gap control
pagebreak - Force page breaks in PDF output
text - Styled text with size, color, weight options
quote - Block quotes and pull quotes
table - Tables with header, striped, bordered options
list - Ordered/unordered lists with custom markers
checkbox - Task items with checked state
image - Images with width, caption, and alt text
icon - Lucide icons with size and color
tag - Badges and labels with variants
progress - Progress bars and circle indicators
hero - Hero sections with gradient backgrounds
card - Cards with optional icon and shadow
Arrange elements horizontally with flexible gap and alignment options.
Syntax highlighting with custom TextMate grammar
Live Preview - See rendered output in a side panel
Theme Studio - Visual theme editor with live preview (Ctrl+Shift+T)
Component Browser - Sidebar with all components by category
Search Components - Quick picker to find and insert components
HTML - Standalone documents with embedded CSS
SVG - For embedding in READMEs and documentation
poly build document.poly --style corporate # Apply a style preset
poly build document.poly --spacing compact # Apply spacing preset
Polyester's theme system is built on three composable modules—style, spacing, and
Control colors, fonts, borders, and shadows. Built-in presets:
Clean blue on white, system fonts
Deep blue, Inter font, tight borders
Purple accent, warm background, Nunito font
Control density—margins, gaps, and padding. Built-in presets: compact, default, spacious.
Mix any style with any spacing. Set them via /page flags or CLI flags:
poly style list # List available style presets
poly spacing list # List available spacing presets
Presets resolve to CSS custom properties (--poly-color-primary, --poly-spacing-base, etc.)
Import colorschemes from your terminal configuration as syntax themes:
Supported formats: Xresources, kitty, alacritty, pywal, base16.
The VS Code extension includes a visual theme editor. Open it with Ctrl+Shift+T (or
Polyester: Open Theme Studio from the command palette).
Color pickers for all 14 design tokens
Font selectors for body, heading, and mono
Switch between style presets to use as a starting point
Preview against a reference document or your own .poly file
Export as a reusable JSON style module or copy CSS variables
Polyester ships an MCP server (poly-mcp) so AI assistants can author .poly documents
Browse all components, filter by category
